collection.name: railLoadGroups
collection.doc: 🛤️ Rail load group of EN 1991-2, Table 6.11 (gr11 to gr31): the component factors entered from the table and the group actions of the LM71 axle, the LM71 distributed load, the longitudinal and the lateral force the design assumes.

fields.name: load_group
fields.doc: 🛤️ gr11 | gr12 | ... | gr31 of Table 6.11 (anything else is an invalid input).

fields.name: factor_vertical
fields.doc: ⬇️ Factor of the vertical loads (LM71, SW/0) of the group, entered from Table 6.11.

fields.name: factor_longitudinal
fields.doc: ↔️ Factor of the traction and braking force of the group, entered from Table 6.11.

fields.name: factor_lateral
fields.doc: ↕️ Factor of the lateral force (nosing) of the group, entered from Table 6.11.

fields.name: assumed_axle_load
fields.doc: 🏋️ LM71 axle load [N] of the group the design assumes (factor times alpha times 250 kN).

fields.name: assumed_udl
fields.doc: 📏 LM71 distributed load [N/m] of the group the design assumes.

fields.name: assumed_longitudinal
fields.doc: ↔️ Traction or braking force [N] of the group the design assumes.

fields.name: assumed_lateral
fields.doc: ↕️ Lateral force (nosing) [N] of the group the design assumes.
